posts: The cloud is not the safe default for your client data. Local AI agents keep proprietary data on the machine, a 9B-parameter model runs on a consumer GPU with 12 GB of VRAM, routine work avoids per-token cloud fees, and you keep frontier models only for the long, multi-step reasoning jobs where they clearly win. That is the whole argument, and it fits on one desk.
12 GB of VRAM is now enough for everyday drafting work.
